identity.name: Open Frame
identity.intro: A place for photographs to become stories. Landscape, light, and the spaces in between.

about.title: Look a little longer.
paragraphs: A photograph can hold a place, a gesture, a moment of quiet. This portfolio gives each sequence its own space, with room for both the whole scene and the smallest detail.
Open Frame is a reusable demonstration portfolio. Change the identity, add your own sessions, and make this space yours.

contact.note: Contact details will appear here when this portfolio is ready for enquiries.

seo.title: Open Frame — Photography portfolio
seo.description: A photographic portfolio of light, landscape and quiet forms. A reusable demonstration template, ready for your own sessions.
